comments.author: Simon
comments.text:
Hi Aleeze,

Don't worry. I'm sure it was in part 1 - in this part the examiner must read all of the questions. Sometimes this happens:

Examiner: Do you work or are you a student?

Student: I work in a hospital and I like my job because I meet new people every day.

Examiner: Do you like your job?

The examiner knows that the student has already answered the second question, but he/she must read it anyway! This won't affect the student's score.
